priorExposure: v0 performance and 2025-07-17 missing terminal auction already observed; this contract is a new, prospective accounting measurement, not a revision of v0 or a new EXIT

scope.cohort: exact R50 OOF score window, 34 frozen sessions, IM 1150 / R1 1107 Entry fills; not 58-session / 2155-Opportunity full period

valuationOptions.source: pinned allowlisted raw one-minute OHLCV; reference is CLOSE of latest completed owned-symbol bar since Entry in the current continuous trading segment; exact 15:30 single-price auction when actually observed; pinned raw Entry-minute OPEN at the Entry time for newly funded position, distinct from cost-inclusive effective Entry
valuationOptions.referenceRule: For held position at event minute T in a segment, choose the greatest raw source minute m in that same segment with m>=Entry minute and m+1<=T, bar CLOSE finite positive, sourceTimestamp=knownAt=m+1. If no such bar is available but the confirmed Entry OPEN was observed in this segment, retain that raw OPEN with sourceTimestamp=knownAt=Entry minute. At 15:30 prefer an observed single-price auction at exactly 930, otherwise use last completed afternoon bar. Newly admitted position uses exact raw Entry-minute OPEN tagged ENTRY_RAW_OPEN, never cost-inclusive effective Entry as a market mark or an unclosed bar HIGH/LOW/CLOSE.
valuationOptions.staleness: Historical last-known trade is permitted only within the same continuous trading segment and session. Record staleMinutes=T-knownAt and original raw minute for each mark. No crossing lunch, session boundary, or into following day; no synthetic/executable price claim.
valuationOptions.noObservedMark: null for that position, null total gross exposure, unrealized PnL and equity; do not substitute cost/zero PnL/previous-day prices; new ranked Entry sizing rejects with explicit missing-valuation reason

accounting.executionVsValuation: Only confirmed R50_B 15:30 auction EXIT produces realized cash and charged sell cost. A last-known mark only measures an owned position; it is never a sale, execution, order, or prospective fill.
accounting.missingTerminalAuction: CENSORED_UNRESOLVED_NO_CASH_RELEASE; retain actual quantity and original purchase cost, reserve capacity and cash; retain locked ownership as an accounting uncertainty across sessions without claiming that the intraday strategy chose overnight holding
accounting.nextSession: No retrospective terminal fill, no later price as prior 15:30 sale, no automated next-session EXIT or resumption of the strategy for the censored position. It remains unresolved and blocks new same-symbol Entry; all subsequent valuation requires contemporaneous source and corporate-action proof.
accounting.corporateActions: No verified between-session split/dividend adjustment lineage is available for an unresolved cross-session position in these frozen inputs. Even if a later raw mark happens to be present, block mark-to-market of this carried position until both price and adjustment continuity are certified. Never silently compare a later adjusted price to unadjusted cost.
accounting.cashAndOpenBasis: realized cash equals initial cash minus confirmed purchases plus confirmed auction proceeds minus single sell cost; unmatched open positions keep 100-share quantity and frozen effective Entry cost; realized PnL from confirmed exits only; unrealized PnL = marked notional minus open cost only where every open position mark is valid
eventOrdering: mark every remaining open position at as-of NOW
deterministic R35 rank and R37 equity/MAX_N 100-share sizing
fund admitted Entry from nonnegative cash
accounting.sameTimeRelease: only confirmed EXIT proceeds are available for same-time Entry sizing; valuation marks never generate cash
accounting.positionAndCash: initial JPY 1000000, LONG/CASH only, lot 100, cash >=0, MAX3 primary/MAX4/MAX5 sensitivity, no margin/leverage/short/borrow/collateral reuse
accounting.equity: cash + sum(markPrice * open quantity) only if every open position has certified event-time causal mark and corporate-action continuity; otherwise null. Cash and realized PnL remain known even when equity is null.
accounting.terminalWindow: end of 34-session window retains unresolved censored position and original basis; final marked equity reported only if valid mark exists, full-period Portfolio Return additionally requires all scheduled event equity valid and no final unresolved EXIT. Full-period MaxDD only if all scheduled event equity valid. Partial observed segments are clearly labeled and cannot be concatenated through null.
accounting.lunchAndBoundaries: no pre-lunch price carried to the afternoon; no cross-session mark, overnight fill, auction substitute, or retrospectively backdated mark

rankAndEvaluator.rankKnownAt: must not exceed frozen Entry timestamp
rankAndEvaluator.sizing: unchanged R37 target=current valid marked equity/MAX_N, floor min(target, available cash) to 100-share lot; missing equity rejects; no refit or new ranker
rankAndEvaluator.enrichment: Reuse audited frozen-rank-first v0 Top1/Top3/Top5 results; any v1 funded attribution occurs strictly after six replays and never feeds decision

outputsAndValidity.fullLedger: event timestamp, cash, realized PnL, every position id/quantity/cost/source bar/mark/source knownAt/stale minutes/unrealized, gross exposure/equity/null reason, unresolved count, capacity and utilization
outputsAndValidity.curves: six time ordered timestamp/equity/cash/exposure/utilization/drawdown CSV and plots; nulls remain explicit gaps, no line through unknown span; plot partial only if incomplete
outputsAndValidity.missingReferences: all invalid timestamps and each unresolved open position with missing eligible source reference, including required segment, knownAt/corporate-action reason; never omit or convert null

reproducibility: one exact canonical serialized result is generated twice byte-identically; source manifest and protocol hash pinned by CI and replay
